Good morning, growth team. This week is all about the inbox: what makes people open, what makes them stay, and what makes them leave without a word.

The rundown

Five subject lines that doubled opens: A study of 40,000 sends found that plain questions beat clever puns by a wide margin.

Why your welcome email gets ignored: The first email sets the habit, and most of them ask for too much too soon.

The case for sending less often: Three newsletters cut their cadence in half and kept every paying reader.

Unsubscribes are a feature: A smaller list that reads every issue is worth more to sponsors than a big one that doesn't.

  • Tools we tried this week: Acme, Beta and Gamma

That's all for this week. See you Thursday.
